jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer, System Experience - Proactive
jobs.description:
The Agentic Search team creates the next generation of intelligent, on-device search experiences across Apple products. In this role, you will collaborate with machine learning, app engineering, and infrastructure teams to build responsive, personalized capabilities powered by agentic technologies. You will partner across the company to design features that balance advanced intelligence with Apple's commitment to user privacy.  
  
**Description**  
  
As a Machine Learning Engineer on the System Experience team, you will integrate personal search technologies directly into applications across Apple platforms. You will design durable, reusable architectures and public-facing interfaces for third-party developers, incorporating data across multiple systems while upholding on-device privacy standards. This role requires close cross-functional partnership with OS framework, machine learning, and services teams to optimize system performance and tailor intelligent features for every Apple device.","responsibilities":"Integrate on-device personal search technologies with system applications across iOS, macOS, and other Apple platforms.  
  
Design and build reusable software architectures, frameworks, and developer-facing APIs built for long-term scalability.  
  
Partner with cross-functional machine learning, OS framework, and services teams to adapt and optimize technologies for mobile constraints.  
  
Incorporate multi-system data streams into unified search experiences while safeguarding user privacy on-device.  
  
Balance system trade-offs, profiling, and runtime performance to deliver responsive user experiences.  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**  
  
Experience designing public or system-level APIs and developer frameworks.  
  
Experience profiling, diagnosing, and optimizing system-level mobile software performance.  
  
Familiarity with machine learning principles or large language model fundamentals.  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**  
  
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.  
  
4+ years of application development experience with Swift, Objective-C, or an equivalent high-level programming language on iOS or macOS.  
  
Experience developing search systems, including indexing and retrieval technologies.  
  
Experience collaborating cross-functionally and communicating technical concepts to diverse teams.  
  
**Pay & Benefits**  
  
At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is between $150,400 and $277,600, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.  
  
Apple employees also have the opportunity to become an Apple shareholder through participation in Apple's discretionary employee stock programs. Apple employees are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards, and can purchase Apple stock at a discount if voluntarily participating in Apple's Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You'll also receive benefits including: Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefits, a range of discounted products and free services, and for formal education related to advancing your career at Apple, reimbursement for certain educational expenses - including tuition. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments as well as relocation. Learn more about Apple Benefits

jobs.title: Mid-Level Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

We are looking for a Mid-Level Software Engineer with 2–5 years of experience to build and maintain production-grade integrations and data pipelines at Gryps, the AI platform for construction capital program owners. You should be a strong Python engineer who has real, hands-on experience with integration work: making API calls at scale, handling rate limits, async processes, retries, and orchestration tools like Prefect, Dagster, Step Functions, or Airflow. This is a role for a self-starter who is excited to roll up their sleeves, maintain and support critical pipelines, and grow into designing systems over time. You'll join a lean, AI-native team of 20 that has increased engineering output 4–5x and is backed by $7.7M in seed funding from top-tier investors.

**Responsibilities**

* Build, extend, and maintain API integrations at scale, including authentication, pagination, rate limiting, retries/backoff, idempotency, and error handling.
* Collaborate closely with senior engineers and Forward Deployed Engineers to translate field insights into durable, reliable product capabilities
* Implement and operate orchestrated data workflows and pipelines using tools like Prefect, Dagster, AWS Step Functions, or Airflow
* Support and maintain production pipelines day-to-day, investigating issues, improving resilience, and reducing repeat incidents
* Deliver well-scoped backend projects from requirements through implementation, testing, rollout, and monitoring.

**Experience**

* Hands-​on experience with API integrations at scale (rate limiting,​ retries,​ async,​ error handling)
* 2 -​ 5 years of experience in backend software engineering.
* Worked at an early-​stage B2B SaaS startup (seed to Series B).
* Hands-​on AWS experience (Lambda,​ Step Functions,​ ECS,​ SQS,​ CDK).
* **Tech stack:** Python, AWS Lambda, AWS Step Functions, AWS ECS/Fargate, AWS SQS, AWS EventBridge, AWS CloudWatch, AWS CDK, REST APIs, OAuth, Webhooks, Prefect, Dagster, Airflow, LLM/VLM APIs, Browser Automation/RPA, Vue, React

Join us to be part of a forward-thinking team dedicated to creating innovative solutions that make a difference!

Pay: $140,000.00 - $160,000.00 per year

Application Question(s):

* Walk us through your hands-on experience building or maintaining integration pipelines using tools like Prefect, Dagster, Step Functions, Temporal, or Airflow: what did you own and how long did you work with it?
* Describe a project where you built API integrations at scale: how did you handle rate limiting, async processes, retries, and failure recovery?
* What is their salary expectation?
* Are you able to work in New York and come into the office 3 times per week?

Education:

* Bachelor's (Required)

Location:

* New York, NY (Required)

Work Location: Hybrid remote in New York, NY

jobs.title: Software Engineer III - Market Risk Reporting & Visualization
jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

We have an exciting opportunity for an experienced software engineer to shape the next generation of market risk reporting and analytics.

As a Software Engineer III in the Market Risk Data Visualization Team, you will provide hands-on technical leadership for data products that help risk professionals understand a large, complex, and fast-moving market risk environment. You will design and deliver high-quality analytical datasets, reporting pipelines, and visualization-ready views using PySpark, SQL, and modern cloud data platforms. You will work closely with risk managers, quantitative and data teams, product partners, and other engineers to turn complex business questions into clear, trusted, and useful reporting.

The team is advancing AI-enabled engineering practices to improve how it analyzes requirements, develops and tests pipelines, and delivers reporting capabilities. You will help establish effective patterns for this work, including sound engineering controls and human review, while remaining accountable for the quality, security, and correctness of production outcomes.

**Job Responsibilities**

* Design, build, and maintain production PySpark and SQL pipelines for market risk reporting and analytics.
* Transform complex source data into well-defined, reusable datasets and views for dashboards, reports, and analytical applications.
* Work with business partners and risk subject-matter experts to understand requirements, trace data needs, and deliver fit-for-purpose solutions.
* Apply data modeling, data quality, lineage, and governance practices so reporting outputs are consistent, traceable, and trusted.
* Develop secure, readable, and maintainable code; participate in design discussions, code reviews, and continuous improvement.
* Build and maintain automated tests and deployment workflows, and support monitoring and operational stability of data products.
* Investigate data discrepancies, performance bottlenecks, and production issues, and implement durable fixes.
* Use enterprise-authorized AI-assisted engineering tools to accelerate coding, testing, documentation, and troubleshooting while checking results for correctness, security, and performance.
* Explore practical uses of AI and automation in reporting and analysis, incorporating appropriate validation and human review.
* Collaborate effectively with other engineers, business stakeholders, and platform teams to deliver work in an agile environment.

**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, data science, engineering, applied mathematics, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* Strong professional experience developing and supporting production software or data engineering solutions.
* Strong Python and PySpark skills, with solid SQL and understanding of distributed processing concepts.
* Experience building data pipelines on a cloud data platform or lakehouse, working with large datasets and cloud object storage.
* Knowledge of data modeling, data quality, and the design of reliable datasets for analytics and reporting.
* Experience with software development fundamentals, including version control, testing, code review, CI/CD, and production support.
* Ability to analyze business and technical requirements and turn them into clear, maintainable implementations.
* Experience using approved AI-assisted development tools, with care to review and test generated output rather than relying on it without validation.
* Strong problem-solving, communication, and teamwork skills.
* Interest in financial markets, market risk, or other complex data domains.

**Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Experience with Databricks, Apache Spark, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, and Amazon Web Services.
* Experience preparing data for dashboards, visualization tools, regulatory reporting, or analytical applications.
* Familiarity with data governance, lineage, data observability, and data product practices.
* Exposure to LLMs, agentic AI, or automation techniques applied to software development or data workflows.
* Experience with APIs or services for accessing analytical data.
* Knowledge of market risk concepts such as sensitivities, Value at Risk, stress testing, or limits.
* Experience tuning Spark workloads and improving pipeline performance, reliability, or cost.

Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.

We offer a competitive total rewards package including base salary determined based on the role, experience, skill set and location. Those in eligible roles may receive commission-based pay and/or discretionary incentive compensation, paid in the form of cash and/or forfeitable equity, awarded in recognition of individual achievements and contributions. jobs.title: Software Engineer, Cleared (TS/SCI)
jobs.description:
Government technology has failed citizens, veterans, public servants, and service members for decades.

Kaizen powers America’s application layer. We replace the legacy systems federal agencies run on with modern software, built with craft. The ticketing platform a resident uses to visit a presidential library. The marketplace DoW uses to procure counter-drone systems to protect lives and critical infrastructure. The system a Veteran uses to access benefits. We build systems of record, of national consequence. Our AI-native modules and harness allow us to do so in weeks, not years.

This year, our revenue has grown 35x. Next year, our software will serve over 100 million Americans across dozens of federal agencies.

Founded in 2022 and based in New York City and DC, Kaizen has raised $35 million from NEA, a16z, Accel, 776, and Carpenter Capital.

**Clearance and Eligibility**
-----------------------------

**This role requires an active Top Secret or TS/SCI clearance. United States citizenship is required, because it is a condition of eligibility for the clearance the role depends on.**

**The Role**
------------

Most government software was built for compliance, not for the people who use it. Kaizen is changing that, and the engineers who work here are the reason it's possible. At the senior level, this role carries more than code: you're shaping how AI-native features get designed, scoped, and shipped across a platform that millions of Americans touch when they need something from their government. You'll be one of a small number of engineers with direct influence over what gets built and how: setting technical direction, mentoring teammates, and driving decisions that stick.

**Location**
------------

This is a hybrid role based out of our New York or DC. Candidates must reside or be able to commute to New York City or DC to work out of our office at least four times a week (Monday - Thursday).

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Architect and ship full-stack features end-to-end, from scoping and technical design through build, iteration, and production
* Build and integrate against the Palantir stack: Foundry ontologies and pipelines, AIP agents, and Maven Smart System workflows
* Build inside classification and data-handling constraints rather than around them
* Lead the development of AI-powered product surfaces: intelligent intake flows, real-time constituent assistants, automated case routing, agency operator dashboards
* Set technical direction and raise the bar on code quality. Your decisions become the patterns the rest of the team builds on
* Engage directly with federal agency stakeholders to translate messy real-world requirements into clean, shippable product
* Own platform reliability and performance at government scale: real SLAs, real users, no abstraction layer between you and accountability
* Mentor earlier-career engineers through code review, pairing, and direct technical feedback

**What You'll Bring**
---------------------

* 3+ years of professional engineering experience, with a track record of owning complex features and systems, not just executing on them
* Hands-on development experience with Palantir Foundry, AIP, or Maven Smart System. You have modeled against the ontology, shipped pipelines or AIP agents, and can say what the platform does well and where you had to work around it
* Deep fluency in React / Next.js and Node.js / TypeScript / Postgres. Fast, not just functional
* AI coding tools (Cursor, Copilot, Claude) are already baked into how you work. You've shipped with them, and you move measurably faster because of it
* You've built something real: a product, an open source project, a system you designed and stood behind
* Proven ability to operate in ambiguity: you define the problem as often as you solve it, and you don't stall waiting for the answer to come to you
* A genuine orientation toward the end user, the person on the other side of the screen isn't an abstraction to you

**Strong Candidates May Also...**
---------------------------------

* Have shipped software inside a classified or otherwise accredited environment, and know where the real friction lives
* Have been a Forward Deployed Engineer, or worked a program where Palantir was prime and you were the one making the integration actually work
* Have touched federal, state, or local government tech, or have built in other regulated, high-stakes environments where the constraints were real
* Have cloud deployment depth: AWS, Vercel, GitHub Actions, ECS/Fargate
* Have experience with design systems and component libraries and a clear opinion on when a component is right vs. just functional
* Have led technical work in an early-stage environment where the job was figuring it out, not following a playbook

**What Kaizen Offers**
----------------------

**Health & Insurance**

* 100% coverage across the board: medical through Oxford/United (Gold and Platinum PPO plans), dental through Guardian PPO, and vision through Beam — all fully covered for employees, with 100% coverage for dependents.
* $100,000 in fully paid life insurance. FSA and Dependent Care FSA.
* One Medical membership, on us — same-day primary care, 24/7 virtual visits, and offices all over the city.
* Fertility and family-building support through Carrot.
* 401(k) through Guideline, with a 2% company match.

**Family & Time Off**

* 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave for birthing parents. 10 weeks fully paid for non-birthing parents.
* Unlimited PTO, with a two-week minimum (we mean it when we say take time off!)
* Closed for all federal holidays.
* Company-wide winter break the week of Christmas.
* Company offsites throughout the year.

**Office & Remote Setup**

* Up to $750 one-time home office or desk setup stipend for NYC-based employees. $500 for remote employees.
* $50/month commuter benefit (company contribution).
* Expensed lunch while in the office.
* Dinner and Uber rides home will be expensed if you cho

jobs.title: Software Developer
jobs.description:
**Job Overview**

We are seeking a dynamic and innovative Software Developer to join our technology team! In this role, you will be at the forefront of designing, developing, and maintaining scalable software solutions that power our digital platforms. Your expertise will drive the creation of robust applications, ensuring seamless integration across diverse systems and cloud infrastructure. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment where agile development practices are embraced, and you’re passionate about crafting high-quality code, this opportunity is perfect for you! Join us to shape the future of software engineering and make a tangible impact through cutting-edge technology.

**Duties**

* Develop, test, and deploy web applications using programming languages such as JavaScript, Python, Java, and C++, ensuring high performance and scalability.
* Design system architectures employing design patterns and microservices principles to support scalable and maintainable solutions.
* Build and optimize RESTful APIs for seamless communication between front-end interfaces and back-end services.
* Collaborate within Agile teams to plan sprints, conduct code reviews, and continuously improve development processes using version control tools like GitHub, SVN, and Git.
* Integrate cloud infrastructure services such as AWS to enhance application deployment, scalability, and security.
* Implement security best practices including RBAC (Role-Based Access Control) to safeguard data and systems.
* Participate in system design discussions for new features or system upgrades, ensuring alignment with business goals and technical standards.

**Skills**

* Strong proficiency in software development with experience in web development frameworks like React Express and JavaScript frameworks.
* Deep understanding of IT infrastructure components including Linux environments, cloud infrastructure (AWS), and network protocols such as REST.
* Knowledge of database management systems like MySQL and SQL for data storage solutions.
* Experience with Agile software development methodologies to promote iterative progress and team collaboration.
* Familiarity with software design patterns, microservices architecture, scalability considerations, and system design for large-scale applications.
* Hands-on experience with version control systems such as GitHub or SVN to manage code repositories effectively.
* Ability to develop APIs (Application Programming Interfaces) that enable efficient communication between different software components.
* Understanding of CI/CD pipelines for automated testing, integration, and deployment processes.
* Knowledge of programming languages including Java, Python, C++, VBA, and C for diverse application development needs.
* Experience working with front-end development tools like JavaScript frameworks (React) for creating engaging user interfaces.

Join us as a Software Developer to innovate boldly! Bring your technical expertise into a collaborative environment where your contributions directly influence our technological growth. We value passionate problem-solvers eager to develop scalable systems that make a difference worldwide!

Pay: $125,910.77 - $151,634.47 per year

Work Location: In person

You will design and deliver high-quality analytical datasets, reporting pipelines, and visualization-ready views using PySpark, SQL, and modern cloud data platforms. You will work closely with risk managers, quantitative and data teams, product partners, and other engineers to turn complex business questions into clear, trusted, and useful reporting.

new_jobs.description:
Government technology has failed citizens, veterans, public servants, and service members for decades.

Kaizen powers America’s application layer. We replace the legacy systems federal agencies run on with modern software, built with craft. The ticketing platform a resident uses to visit a presidential library. The marketplace DoW uses to procure counter-drone systems to protect lives and critical infrastructure. The system a Veteran uses to access benefits. We build systems of record, of national consequence. Our AI-native modules and harness allow us to do so in weeks, not years.

This year, our revenue has grown 35x. Next year, our software will serve over 100 million Americans across dozens of federal agencies.

Founded in 2022 and based in New York City and DC, Kaizen has raised $35 million from NEA, a16z, Accel, 776, and Carpenter Capital.

**Clearance and Eligibility**
-----------------------------

**This role requires an active Top Secret or TS/SCI clearance. United States citizenship is required, because it is a condition of eligibility for the clearance the role depends on.**

**The Role**
------------

Most government software was built for compliance, not for the people who use it. Kaizen is changing that, and the engineers who work here are the reason it's possible. At the senior level, this role carries more than code: you're shaping how AI-native features get designed, scoped, and shipped across a platform that millions of Americans touch when they need something from their government. You'll be one of a small number of engineers with direct influence over what gets built and how: setting technical direction, mentoring teammates, and driving decisions that stick.

**Location**
------------

This is a hybrid role based out of our New York or DC. Candidates must reside or be able to commute to New York City or DC to work out of our office at least four times a week (Monday - Thursday).

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Architect and ship full-stack features end-to-end, from scoping and technical design through build, iteration, and production
* Build and integrate against the Palantir stack: Foundry ontologies and pipelines, AIP agents, and Maven Smart System workflows
* Build inside classification and data-handling constraints rather than around them
* Lead the development of AI-powered product surfaces: intelligent intake flows, real-time constituent assistants, automated case routing, agency operator dashboards
* Set technical direction and raise the bar on code quality. Your decisions become the patterns the rest of the team builds on
* Engage directly with federal agency stakeholders to translate messy real-world requirements into clean, shippable product
* Own platform reliability and performance at government scale: real SLAs, real users, no abstraction layer between you and accountability
* Mentor earlier-career engineers through code review, pairing, and direct technical feedback

**What You'll Bring**
---------------------

* 3+ years of professional engineering experience, with a track record of owning complex features and systems, not just executing on them
* Hands-on development experience with Palantir Foundry, AIP, or Maven Smart System. You have modeled against the ontology, shipped pipelines or AIP agents, and can say what the platform does well and where you had to work around it
* Deep fluency in React / Next.js and Node.js / TypeScript / Postgres. Fast, not just functional
* AI coding tools (Cursor, Copilot, Claude) are already baked into how you work. You've shipped with them, and you move measurably faster because of it
* You've built something real: a product, an open source project, a system you designed and stood behind
* Proven ability to operate in ambiguity: you define the problem as often as you solve it, and you don't stall waiting for the answer to come to you
* A genuine orientation toward the end user, the person on the other side of the screen isn't an abstraction to you

**Strong Candidates May Also...**
---------------------------------

* Have shipped software inside a classified or otherwise accredited environment, and know where the real friction lives
* Have been a Forward Deployed Engineer, or worked a program where Palantir was prime and you were the one making the integration actually work
* Have touched federal, state, or local government tech, or have built in other regulated, high-stakes environments where the constraints were real
* Have cloud deployment depth: AWS, Vercel, GitHub Actions, ECS/Fargate
* Have experience with design systems and component libraries and a clear opinion on when a component is right vs. just functional
* Have led technical work in an early-stage environment where the job was figuring it out, not following a playbook

**What Kaizen Offers**
----------------------

**Health & Insurance**

* 100% coverage across the board: medical through Oxford/United (Gold and Platinum PPO plans), dental through Guardian PPO, and vision through Beam — all fully covered for employees, with 100% coverage for dependents.
* $100,000 in fully paid life insurance. FSA and Dependent Care FSA.
* One Medical membership, on us — same-day primary care, 24/7 virtual visits, and offices all over the city.
* Fertility and family-building support through Carrot.
* 401(k) through Guideline, with a 2% company match.

**Family & Time Off**

* 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave for birthing parents. 10 weeks fully paid for non-birthing parents.
* Unlimited PTO, with a two-week minimum (we mean it when we say take time off!)
* Closed for all federal holidays.
* Company-wide winter break the week of Christmas.
* Company offsites throughout the year.

**Office & Remote Setup**

* Up to $750 one-time home office or desk setup stipend for NYC-based employees. $500 for remote employees.
* $50/month commuter benefit (company contribution).
